diagnostics.message: :module.csi: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`:module.csi` has an explicit `depends_on = [module.eks]`, but it already depends on `module.eks` implicitly through attribute references (`eks_name = module.eks.cluster.name` and `oidc = module.eks.oidc` in the addons configuration). The explicit `depends_on` duplicates this data dependency and can be removed.
